note: The Masinloc municipal leadership record. Every profile carries a name and an office, and nothing else. Adding or changing a leader means editing this file and running scripts/build-leadership.py; leadership.html is generated and must never be hand-edited.
rules: Name and office status only. No terms, dates, party, achievements, family relationships, biography or quotations.
Every portrait is rendered at the same aspect ratio, the same widths and the same quality. No leader is enlarged, sharpened, retouched or framed differently from another.
The incumbent is listed first because she holds the office. That is an information hierarchy, not a ranking, and it must not be expressed as a larger card or a louder treatment.
The former mayors are listed in the order supplied. No chronology is inferred and no term dates are invented.
Spelling of names is fixed. Do not add or remove middle names, initials or honorifics.
Portraits come from the project's approved originals. No AI portraits, no facial alteration, no per-person beautification.
Warmth is allowed and wanted. The restraint in these rules is about facts, not about tone: say nothing the page cannot show, and say it gladly.

page.title: The people who have carried the responsibility of leading Masinloc.
page.description: The Municipal Mayor of Masinloc, Zambales now in office and the mayors who held the office before her, presented as a portrait record of name and office.
page.lead: Masinloc has been led by many Masinloqueños across its history. Five of their portraits hang together here — the mayor serving now and four who held the office before her, each given the same place on the page. The record is open, and it grows as more portraits are confirmed.
page.provenance: This page keeps to names and offices; the rest of each story belongs to the people who lived it. Discover Masinloc is an independent community platform, not an official municipal government website — for official records and public services, please refer to the appropriate government offices.

womenInLeadership.heading: Women in Leadership
womenInLeadership.fact: Masinloc has been continuously led by women since 2010.
womenInLeadership.note: Three women, three administrations, one continuous stretch of leadership that belongs to all of them.
womenInLeadership.claimRule: Only the sentence above is approved. Do not upgrade it to a national claim — no 'first', no 'longest in the Philippines', no 'record'. Any stronger statement needs an authoritative source first, and would then belong in data/sources.json like every other sourced claim.
